Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by failing to perform due diligence when initially analyzing the results and formulating the plan for further steps. Multiple inconsistencies and conflicting sources for Korn Ferry’s founding year were noted early on (1943 vs. 1969), but the Planner did not prioritize authoritative sources or verify the conflicting results effectively. This mistake led to continuous cycles of Web queries without making solid advances toward resolving the dispute. Proper synthesis or decision-making would have focused on resolving which source was more authoritative early in the process, avoiding redundancy and ambiguity later in the conversation.
